About WVVH-TV: 

WVVH-TV, Hamptons TV® is the largest FCC licensed TV station in Suffolk County, broadcasting on UHF Channel 50, Cablevision 78, Verizon FiOS Channel 14 . Hamptons TV® is seen throughout New York, New Jersey and Westchester worldwide, YouTUBE Broadcast partner and at webstream www.wvvh.tv and is the official TV station for the Hampton Classic Horse Show (Winner 2008 Telly Award) and Hamptons International Film Festival (Winner 2008 Telly Award) and the State designated station for Amber Alerts and National Hurricane emergency broadcast. 2007 Award Winner for Best Childrens Programming - New York State Broadcasters Association. Website: www.wvvh.com
